tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Vide disclosure dated February 04, 2025, the Company had informed about a GST demand of Rs 20.38 crore (comprising tax of Rs 10.19 crore and an equivalent penalty) raised by the CGST Commissionerate, Noida, relating to utilisation of Input Tax Credit through TRAN-1. The Company's appeal before the Commissioner (Appeals) was dismissed vide order dated April 02, 2026, upholding the demand.

operating_notes.text: Group increased provision for employee benefits by ₹90.72 million following notification of new Labour Codes.
FY26 collections were ₹1,857 Cr, 12% YoY, and deferred revenue ₹1,965 Cr, 16% YoY, both ahead of 11% revenue growth.
Paying suppliers were 220K at FY26-end, up 1% YoY, with ARPU of ₹67K, up 8% YoY.
About ₹1,300 Cr of capital has been returned to shareholders, including ₹300 Cr distributed in FY26.
Supplier storefronts grew to 8.7 million and paying suppliers stood at 220K at the end of Q4 FY2026.
Total paying suppliers stood at 220,000 at the end of FY26, after a decline of 1,200 in Q4 due to Silver tier price hikes.
BUSY Q1 billing ₹59 Cr (+10% YoY), revenue ₹36 Cr (+47%), deferred revenue ₹146 Cr (+44%), cash from operations ₹16 Cr.
BUSY sold about 12,000 new licenses in Q1, taking cumulative licenses sold to 4.54 lakh.
Platinum and Gold subscribers are about 50% of the customer base and more than 75% of revenue.
Standalone paying suppliers declined by 615 in Q2FY27 to 217K.
Annualised Revenue Per Paying Supplier (ARPU) reached ₹72K in Q2FY27, up 10% YoY.
Busy Infotech Q2FY27 billing stood at ₹46 Cr (+20% YoY) and revenue at ₹37 Cr (+27% YoY).

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹404.3 Cr (+13.9% YoY), net profit ₹50.2 Cr.
IndiaMART reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹404 Cr with a net profit of ₹50 Cr and recommended a total dividend of ₹60 per share.

IndiaMART Q1FY27 call (July 21, 2026): revenue ₹414 Cr (+11% YoY), EBITDA ₹146 Cr at 35% margin, net profit ₹172 Cr; paying suppliers fell 1,850 to 2.18 lakh; board approved new subsidiary IndiaMART Finance Ltd.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹428.6 Cr (+9.6% YoY), net profit ₹90.8 Cr (+9.8% YoY) (includes ₹15.3 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹106.1 Cr).
IndiaMART InterMESH published its Q2FY27 investor presentation reporting consolidated revenue of ₹429 Cr (+10% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹159 Cr (+23% YoY).
Audio and video recording of Earnings Conference Call for Analysts and Investors held on October 27, 2026 is available on the company website.
